# `viewport/CollabOverlayRenderer.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/viewport/CollabOverlayRenderer.js`

CollabOverlayRenderer.js Renders peer cameras as small 3D camcorder-style pyramids in the viewport, with colored tint matching the peer's chosen color and a floating name label. Uses the existing EntityMeshRenderer to draw pyramids (no new GPU pipelines needed). Name labels are HTML overlays positioned via 3D→2D projection.

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(getInterpCameraFn)` |  |
| `ensureContainer` | `ensureContainer(parentEl)` | Ensure the HTML overlay container exists. |
| `renderPeerCameras` | `renderPeerCameras(meshRenderer, renderPass, viewProjMatrix, peers, canvas)` | Render all peer cameras into the current render pass. Call this AFTER entityMeshRenderer.beginFrame() and BEFORE flush(). |
| `updateLabels` | `updateLabels(peers, viewProjMatrix, canvasWidth, canvasHeight)` | Update HTML name labels positioned above each peer's camera. Call once per frame AFTER rendering. |
| `_hideLabel` | `_hideLabel(peerId)` |  |
| `destroy` | `destroy()` |  |

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```
